{{Top}}
'''Red Seven''' was the callsign of the seventh member of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Red Seven.

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Elyhek Rue/Legends|Elyhek Rue]] used the callsign during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SE-ElyhekRue">''{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Elyhek Rue}}''</ref>

[[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] flew as Red Seven during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="DSII-Red7">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 7}}</ref>

[[Red Seven (Tandankin)|An otherwise unidentified pilot]] flying as Red Seven with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in the [[Battle of Tandankin|mission on Tandankin]] was shot down by a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], but survived to discover a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] landing strip in the shadow of a [[Tandankin monument|local monument]].<ref name="XWRSS">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref>
